sentences.text: Sinosaurus is morphologically similar to Dilophosaurus, possessing a similarly shaped cranial crest, though its exact taxonomic relationship remains uncertain.

This medium-sized basal theropod reached about 5.5 meters in length, 1.8 meters at the hip, and weighed 450 kilograms.

The genus Sinosaurus was named by Young in 1948.
The name Sinosaurus is derived from the Latin word for Chinese and the Greek word for lizard.
